title: (Senior) Consultant Sustainability Advisory | Climate Tech startup
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Carbmee
description_html:
Intro

In this high-impact role, you will work with leading industrial companies to turn climate targets into decisions, and you will see the result twice: in their P&L and in their emissions curve.

At carbmee, we're building the environmental intelligence platform that the world's largest industrial companies use to measure, manage, and reduce their carbon emissions. We work with companies like Schaeffler, ZF, Knorr Bremse. And we're growing fast!

As (Senior) Consultant, Sustainability Advisory, you'll own client engagements from scoping to delivery, help build the pipeline that funds them, and shape how our advisory offering is packaged as the practice grows. You'll have real responsibility from day one, and what you build here will actually matter.

If you're not just looking for your next job, but your next big step, carbmee is the right next step for your career!

We'd love to hear from you.


Your tasks

  • Deliver billable advisory engagements end to end: scoping, hypothesis-driven analysis, quantification, client deliverables and presentation. You'll lead smaller engagements and drive workstreams on larger ones.
  • Shape and grow our advisory pipeline: turn client and software conversations into scoped opportunities, and write the proposals - approach, scope, pricing - that win them, working closely with Sales.
  • Help productise the advisory offering: turn recurring client questions into repeatable, priced packages with clear deliverables, duration and day rates.
  • Act as the sustainability subject matter expert for Sales and the Supplier Engagement team: EU regulation (CBAM, CSRD, EUDR, EU ETS), Scope 3 methodology and decarbonisation levers, supporting deal narratives, workshops and customer sessions.
  • Bridge software and advisory: build advisory work on carbmee's EIS output, feed client needs back into Product, and spot expansion opportunities in accounts.
  • Own the operating discipline for your accounts: time tracking, pipeline hygiene, project margin, and monthly input into the consulting scorecard.


Your profile

  • You've spent 3-6 years in a consulting environment, with sustainability as your core focus, not a side project.
  • You know carbon accounting and decarbonisation (Scope 1/2/3) and EU regulation (CBAM, CSRD, EUDR, EU ETS) well enough to explain their commercial implications to a client.

  • You've contributed to proposals or pitches, not just delivery:  you know how a deal gets won, not only how it gets executed.
  • You're at consulting standard in PowerPoint/Google Slides and Excel/Sheets, with a hypothesis-driven storyline and full ownership of your own numbers.

title: Director Strategic Operations (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Matrix42
description_html:
Your mission

YOUR MISSION
As Director, Strategic Operations, you will act as a force multiplier for our CEO and executive team. You will turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions and measurable execution, while creating the governance and transparency that help our leadership focus on the opportunities with the greatest value for Matrix42.

Your key responsibilities would look like this:

  • Own and continuously improve our leadership operating system and governance cadence across ExCo, XLT, leadership forums and strategic offsites.
  • Drive agenda planning, decision tracking and follow-through, ensuring clear ownership and timely escalation of risks, bottlenecks and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Lead the annual planning process together with Finance and functional leaders, translating company goals into coherent functional plans and measurable targets.
  • Track strategic priorities and value creation initiatives across the organization, creating visibility on progress, milestones, dependencies and execution risks.
  • Increase CEO effectiveness by preparing executive meetings, customer engagements, strategic discussions and leadership communications, and by coordinating resulting actions.
  • Coordinate high-quality materials, reporting and follow-up for the Board of Directors and our private equity sponsor.
  • Strengthen organizational alignment through clear executive messaging, visibility of company priorities and more efficient, AI-enabled ways of working.


Your profile

YOUR PROFILE

Must Have

  • At least 7 years of experience in business operations, executive office, transformation, program management, consulting, Chief of Staff or a comparable leadership-adjacent role.
  • A strong track record of managing complex, cross-functional initiatives and working closely with executive leadership teams.
  • Excellent planning, organizational and program management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through and a strong execution focus.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to understand business priorities quickly, connect strategy with execution and influence without formal authority.
  • Analytical and financial fluency, including confidence working with financial models, KPI packages and board-level information.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex information into clear, decision-ready executive materials and presentations.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken, high ownership and sound judgement when handling confidential and sensitive information.
Nice to Have
  • Experience in a SaaS, software or technology environment.
  • Experience with Board or private equity sponsor preparation, reporting and governance.
  • Fluency in German.

Why us?

title: Associate Product Owner
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Glassdollar
description_html:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on.
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good.
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide.
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard.
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day.
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow.
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.


What you'll do

Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday.

  • Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
  • Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
  • Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
  • Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
  • Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients

What you'll be scoping over your first year:
  • Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
  • Public REST APIs and MCP servers, so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
  • AI embedded across the product, inside the surfaces people already work in.
  • Workflow automation inside the platform, so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
  • Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
  • Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
Nice to have:
  • B2B enterprise SaaS background
  • Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
  • Notion fluency

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.


How we hire

Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.

  1. Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
  2. Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample: a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed
  3. Interview
  4. Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around

description_html:
Your mission

Deine Mission: Werde zum Wachstumsmotor von Deutschlands größter Nachbarschaftsplattform
Du willst nicht nur Media-Budgets verwalten, sondern den Markt aktiv gestalten? Du hast den Instinkt für große Deals und die Ausdauer, Marken dort zu platzieren, wo sie echtes Vertrauen genießen?
Bei nebenan.de bringen wir starke Brands direkt in das digitale Zuhause von über 4 Millionen aktiven Nutzer:innen. Wir suchen keinen "Verwalter", sondern einen Senior Sales Profi, der unser Werbegeschäft mit Biss, Kreativität und unternehmerischem Mut auf das nächste Level hebt.
Jagdinstinkt trifft Strategie

  • Pipeline-Architekt & Hunter: Du baust dir deinen eigenen Kundenstamm von Grund auf auf. Dabei nutzt du Kaltakquise als Werkzeug und identifizierst durch eigenständige Lead-Recherche – massiv unterstützt durch unsere internen KI-Tools – die Brands, die perfekt zu unserer Plattform passen
  • Deal-Closing auf Entscheiderebene: Du gewinnst große Marken und Mediaagenturen für hyperlokale und nationale Kampagnen. Du begleitest den gesamten Prozess von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum finalen Vertragsabschluss.
  • Scale bigger: Du denkst nicht in Standardpaketen. Du suchst aktiv nach Hebeln, um Budgets zu skalieren, Add-ons zu platzieren und crossmediale Konzepte umzusetzen, die nachhaltig Eindruck hinterlassen.
  • Kreativer Sparringspartner: Du entwickelst proaktiv „um die Ecke gedachte“ Ansätze für deine Kund:innen, um deren Sichtbarkeit und Wirksamkeit auf der Plattform zu maximieren.
  • Vorbild & Mentor:in: Du teilst deine Sales-Experience im Team, pushst die Ambition deiner Kolleg:innen und hilfst uns, als Einheit über uns hinauszuwachsen.


Your profile

Abschlussstärke ist deine DNA

  • Erfahrung: Du bringst 4-5+ Jahre fundierte Erfahrung im Media- oder Ad-Sales mit, idealerweise mit einem Fokus auf Branding- oder Plattformkampagnen. 
  • Erfolgsbilanz: Dein Track Record ist tadellos – du hast bereits nachweislich große Marken überzeugt und signifikante Umsatztreiber etabliert. 
  • Hunter-Mentalität: Du brennst für den Vertrieb. Kaltakquise schreckt dich nicht ab, sondern spornt dich an. Du hast den unbedingten Willen zum Erfolg und arbeitest leidenschaftlich an deinen Zielen.
  • Netzwerk: Du verfügst über ein belastbares Netzwerk in der Agentur- und Markenwelt, das du sofort aktivieren kannst.
  • Mindset: Du denkst groß und mutig. Wo andere Hindernisse sehen, findest du Wege, um das Ticket zu heben und die Idee noch stärker aufzuladen.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbstorganisiert, hochgradig fokussiert und mit einem echten unternehmerischen Spirit.


What we offer

  • Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit einer Kombination aus Büro- und Remote-Tagen
  • Einen sinnstiftenden Job – wir bauen ein großartiges Produkt, das echten Mehrwert für Communities liefert
  • Arbeiten in einem fröhlichen, erfahrenen Team, das Wissen teilt und voneinander lernt
  • Einblicke in den gesamten Arbeitsprozess unseres Social Startups sowie der nebenan.de Stiftung
  • Deine nebenan.de SpenditCard – jeden Monat erhältst Du zusätzlich 35 € zur freien Verfügung
  • 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, plus die Möglichkeit von Workation-Modellen und Sabbaticals
  • Eine stärkenorientierte Entwicklungskultur (wir arbeiten mit dem Gallup StrengthsFinder)
  • Ein Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg und regelmäßige Events wie Yoga oder „Lunch & Learn“-Sessions

Wir bieten dir die Chance, in einem Umfeld zu arbeiten, das Impact mit Performance verbindet. Du gestaltest die Zukunft unseres Advertising-Geschäfts aktiv mit und profitierst von einer Plattform, die als "Zuhause für Marken mit Haltung" echtes Alleinstellungsmerkmal genießt.

description_html:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 
The Purpose:

Senior Fullstack Engineers (m/f/d) at PPRO drive core technical decisions, solving complex technical problems, whilst participating in decisions on architecture and technical direction. Supporting and mentoring engineering colleagues within a hands-on environment. A strong understanding of business context, customer needs, and technical constraints is essential to designing and implementing pragmatic, scalable solutions that address the right problems and deliver sustainable value.


What you’ll do:
  •  Own end-to-end software development processes, from requirements to deployment in our production systems for our key products and services (e.g. accounting and reporting systems)
  • Be an integral part of the team’s culture and ways of working, continuously improving development processes and practices together with your colleagues based on data, feedback, and changing business needs.
  • Use the latest technologies (e.g. React Query, gRPC) to solve real problems for our customers at a massive scale
  • Take e2e operational responsibility for the team-owned components
  • Share technical expertise and architect creative solutions while advancing team best practices

    • What we look for in you:
  • Ability to collaborate and grow dynamic and autonomous environments, whilst in a small, agile team.
  • Impact-oriented, collaborative, empathetic, focused, curious, well-organized, having a continuous improvement mindset and strong sense of responsibility
  • Experience leading design solutions from scratch to impact, heavily supporting them hands-on
  • Working proficiency in English
  • Confident AI-augmented development experience with a focus on a solution quality and cost-efficient usage (Ideally Claude Code)
  • Accounting/Fintech Domain: Experience with—or a strong interest in—the complexities of accounting systems or ledgers is a distinct advantage

    • Technical Requirements:
  •  5+ years of professional experience working with Java/Kotlin and JS/TS
  • Modern frameworks (Spring Boot, React)
  • Strong AWS experience, including efficient cost-management (SNS/SQS, Kinesis, Lambdas; Terraform is a plus)
  • Event-driven + Microservice architectures (Anti-corruption layer, Event Sourcing, CQRS) 
    • What's in it for you?

    Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. title: AI Platform Engineer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at CHAPTERS Group AG
description_html:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You are a core member of the AI Core team, owning the infrastructure that powers AI adoption across 55+ portfolio companies. Your focus is the AI Hub platform (Open WebUI): you keep it running, deploy new instances, build and validate integrations at HQ level, and make sure every company in the group gets a stable, well-configured environment.

We build the AI Hub as a product and support to ship it in every company. Each company owns their HUB and administers it (L1 Support). You are part of the central team that drives features and changes that are of high value for all hubs in the portfolio.

In addition, you are part of the team that serves as the center of expertise (L2 Support) and give guidance and hands-on support when the first level teams need you.

What You Will Work On

  • Platform engineering: new integrations, container images, infrastructure-as-code, deployment tooling and security patches. This is the product that every company runs
  • Release qualification: when the upstream project ships a new version, you assess it (one-way database migrations, breaking changes, patch compatibility), validate it on a canary, and publish a qualified release with notes that an L1 can act on
  • Shared infrastructure: Application Gateway, WAF policies, TLS certificates, Redis, DNS and network peering. This layer is shared across every company and cannot be devolved. A mistake here affects all of them
  • Enable the L1 network and be their technical point of contact: write the developer guides, run onboarding and office hours, and build preflight checks and guardrails that make it safe for a platform admin to deploy and operate their own Hub.
  • Integrations Catalog stewardship: versioned artefacts (tools, skills, agents, integrations) each shipped with a user guide for AI Champions and a developer guide for platform admins
  • Fleet observability: reporting and alerting version parity, uptime, cloud spend and deployment status across all companies.
  • Own the eval service: the service itself, the quality of judges and generators, and the methodology platforms use to measure whether their agents do the work
  • Close the loop. Shipping is the beginning. Your designs gather operational signals from the fleet and feed a continuous improvement cycle

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or cloud operations, including ownership of production systems that others depend on
  • Production cloud experience on Azure or AWS
  • Infrastructure as Code in production: Bicep, Terraform, CDK or CloudFormation. We care that you think in IaC.
  • Strong Python skills beyond scripting: you have built and maintained small production services, worked with APIs, and found your way around unfamiliar codebases
  • Comfortable with Linux, Docker, Git and CI/CD as everyday working tools
  • Working knowledge of databases and identity: PostgreSQL in production, and OAuth / SSO / Entra ID concepts
  • AI-native: you use LLMs as tools, understand their operational properties, and have shipped something with them
  • English (fluent): primary working language across the team; German conversational is a plus

Bonus

  • Clear technical writing: Enabling others is a real part of this role and good documentation is part of the work rather than an afterthought
  • Experience building internal platforms or tooling used by other engineering teams
  • Working in multi-tenant or multi-customer cloud environments
  • Contributions to open-source projects, or maintaining a modified version of one in production
  • Practical experience with LLM frameworks, agents, MCP or RAG systems in production
  • French language skills: a share of our portfolio is in France and growing

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A role that shapes the AI backbone for more than 50 software companies across Europe.
  • Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
  • A small, high-ownership team: decisions get made fast, your work ships to production. You are part of the CTO office with a direct line to the leadership team
  • Daily work with cutting-edge AI technologies.
  • Space to define how AI gets integrated into operational business systems at group scale: early-stage work with lasting impact across 55+ companies
  • Permanent full-time position, remote-first with the option to join the team in the Cologne office
  • A clear path to grow with us: we look for ambitious people who want to build a career, not just take a role. We actively invest in your development: talent reviews, events, conferences, etc.

How to Apply

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

  • Why do you find it exciting to work with vertical market software companies?
  • Why are you the right person to drive AI in the CHAPTERS Group? What is your “unfair advantage”?

We are looking forward to your application!

description_html:
Clariness is looking for a DevOps Engineer (f/m/d) based in Berlin, Hamburg, Cape Town, UK, or Serbia.
- Full-time; unlimited -

About the role:

This role is about ensuring that Clariness' global cloud infrastructure remains reliable, secure and ready to scale. You will join a collaborative technical environment where infrastructure enables our product, data engineering and AI teams to deliver meaningful solutions.

As a DevOps Engineer, you would be responsible for:

  • Building, operating and improving Clariness' global AWS infrastructure, with a particular focus on ECS, RDS and supporting services.
  • Managing infrastructure through Terraform, contributing to reusable, maintainable and version-controlled infrastructure as code. 
  • Improving CI/CD pipelines and container deployment processes to support reliable, secure and efficient software delivery.
  • Supporting our production systems by monitoring infrastructure, troubleshooting incidents and contributing to improvements in reliability, security and cloud cost efficiency.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional product teams, as well as our data engineering and AI teams, to understand their requirements and provide effective infrastructure solutions.
  • Contributing to infrastructure improvement initiatives, maintaining operational documentation and supporting technical excellence across Clariness.

We would like you to have: 

  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience working with production infrastructure on AWS, ideally including ECS, RDS and supporting services.
  • Practical experience with Terraform, including modules, state management and infrastructure changes through version control and code review.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerized applications and production deployments.
  • Familiarity with backup and disaster recovery, high-availability configurations and safe database migrations.
  • The ability to independently deliver well-defined infrastructure tasks, explain technical trade-offs and contribute to architectural discussions.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills (English at C1 level), along with an interest in using AI-assisted tools responsibly to support infrastructure development, testing and troubleshooting.

You may ask now, why should I work for you? Let us give you a few reasons – and you'll learn more during the process.

  • A varied and exciting job with a lot of personal responsibility in an international company, where you can develop and expand your skills.
  • Professional and personal development opportunities - incl. personal development budget.
  • Flexible working hours and mobile working.
  • Regular team events and open feedback culture.
  • A versatile field of activity and challenging projects.
  • A supportive and open company culture, providing the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse and professional team.
  • Impact healthcare by accelerating medical innovation through improved access to clinical trials, potentially bringing needed treatments to patients faster.

How to apply & what to expect: 

  • Apply via link (CV only; no cover letter required).
  • Introductory call (30 min) → Technical interview  → Take Home Test → Demo Day → Decision.
  • We aim to move promptly and keep you updated at every step. 

 

At Clariness, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

For more information, feel free to reach out to

Have we sparked your interest?

Would you like to become part of our dynamic, curious, and international culture with plenty of room for your ideas and creativity in an inspiring atmosphere? If so, we look forward to receiving your application with details of your desired salary and possible starting date, preferably via our application portal.

Clariness GmbH will treat the above information strictly confidential and will especially observe the applicable provisions of the applicable data protection laws. Further information about the use of the applicant data, you will find in the data protection declaration online at https://www.clariness.com/privacy-policy/

title: (Junior) Accounting Specialist (w/m/d)

description_html:
Jobbeschreibung

bonial hilft Dir dabei Zeit, Geld und Papier zu sparen.

Wir sind ein digitaler Werbepartner für das Offline-Business. Wir unterstützen Händler:innen in deren Marketing-Aktivitäten und helfen dabei, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen.

Würdest Du gern dazugehören und Teil des digitalen Wandels im Handel sein?

bonial ist Teil der Axel Springer SE und revolutioniert den Einzelhandel als führender "Drive to Store"-Partner in Deutschland und Frankreich. Über unsere Plattformen "kaufDA" und "MeinProspekt" in Deutschland sowie „Bonial“ in Frankreich verbinden wir täglich Millionen von Nutzer:innen mit ihren Lieblingsgeschäften und -marken – und schaffen dabei echten Mehrwert.

Wir befinden uns in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase, skalieren rasant und verändern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen den Einzelhandel entdecken. Bei bonial arbeiten wir in einem leistungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld, das von motivierten, ergebnisorientierten Menschen geprägt ist, die mit Leidenschaft etwas bewegen wollen.

Wenn Du Teil eines engagierten Teams sein möchtest, das die Zukunft des Einzelhandels gestaltet, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Bei bonial helfen wir Millionen von Nutzer:innen, jeden Tag smarter einzukaufen, über kaufDA, MeinProspekt und unsere Plattformen in Frankreich. Unser Finance-Team sorgt für Transparenz, Genauigkeit und eine verlässliche finanzielle Steuerung des Unternehmens.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Accounting-Teams suchen wir eine:n (Junior) Accounting Specialist (m/w/d). In dieser Rolle unterstützt Du unsere erfahrenen Kolleg:innen im Accounting im operativen Tagesgeschäft sowie bei den Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen. Die Position ist bewusst als Einstiegs- und Support-Rolle angelegt, mit strukturierter Einarbeitung und der Perspektive, Aufgaben Schritt für Schritt eigenständig zu übernehmen.

Deine Aufgaben

• Verarbeitung und Kontierung von Eingangsrechnungen sowie Bearbeitung des zentralen Accounting-Postfachs

• Abrechnung von Kreditkarten und Reisekosten, inklusive der steuerlichen Behandlung

• Bearbeitung von Anzahlungen, Self-Billing sowie eingehenden Mahnungen und Gutschriften

• Pflege der Debitoren, inklusive offener Posten und Mahnwesen

• Unterstützung bei Rückstellungen, Abgrenzungen und Kontenabstimmungen im Rahmen des Monats- und Jahresabschlusses

• Mitarbeit bei der Aufbereitung von Unterlagen für externe Prüfer sowie bei der Transfer-Pricing-Dokumentation

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Accounting- und FP&A-Team zur Sicherung von Datenqualität und reibungslosen Abläufen

Stellenanforderungen

Dein Profil

• Erste Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung, im Accounting oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion, gern auch über eine kaufmännische oder steuerfachliche Ausbildung

• Solides Verständnis grundlegender Buchhaltungsprinzipien und hohe Zahlenaffinität

• Gute Excel-Kenntnisse sowie Bereitschaft, Dich in SAP einzuarbeiten

• Neugier und Offenheit für die Arbeit mit KI-Tools im Finance-Alltag

• Strukturierte, zuverlässige und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Teamorientiert, proaktiv und kommunikativ, mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung

• Interesse, Dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln und schrittweise mehr Verantwortung im Accounting zu übernehmen

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (min. C1) für Rechnungsverarbeitung, Lieferantenkontakt und steuerliche Themen

• Gute Englischkenntnisse (min. B2) für die Zusammenarbeit im internationalen Umfeld

Warum wir?

• Eine klar zugeschnittene Rolle mit strukturierter Einarbeitung, von Shadowing bis zur eigenständigen Übernahme

• Enge Begleitung durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen aus dem Accounting

• Eine solide fachliche Grundlage und Raum, Dich weiterzuentwickeln

• Ein unterstützendes, diverses Team und eine offene Feedbackkultur

Was wir Dir bieten können:

High-Growth Story – bonial ist ein wachstumsstarkes und dynamisches Unternehmen mit dauerhaftem Potenzial für die Zukunft. Wir sind eines der führenden Unternehmen und eine treibende Kraft in einer Branche, die gerade einen massiven, einmaligen Wandel von Print zu Digital erlebt.

Innovation & Tech – Wir sind ein High-Tech-Unternehmen mit Fokus auf innovative Technologien. Wir nutzen KI und andere Tools, um Produktivität und Effizienz zu steigern. Damit verbessern wir kontinuierlich die Leistung unseres Unternehmens und aller, die hier arbeiten – und erzielen gleichzeitig Ergebnisse für unsere Kund:innen und Nutzer:innen.

description_html:
Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) Frankfurt Branch was established in June 1999, which holds the universal bank license of Germany and is a correspondent bank for first class clearing of Euro and a member of the Target2 and SEPA of the Euro Clearing System. ICBC Frankfurt Branch is also the Euro Clearing Center of ICBC Group.

Tasks

  • Assist in managing the bank's Money Market businesses, enrich funding channels, and ensure liquidity safety.
  • Assist in managing the bank's FX and Rate transactions, formulating investment or trading strategies to achieve profit targets, and enhancing the bank's trading capabilities.
  • Monitor market information, promptly update market reports, and provide timely market analysis to the team.
  • Actively participate in new product development, providing support for the expansion of the bank's financial market business.
  • Support client marketing and sales of financial market-related products.
  • Assist in relevant system or platform management and development, enhancing digitalization and automation levels.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, or related disciplines.
  • Minimum of 8 years trading experience in related business.
  • Proficiency in computer applications such as Bloomberg, Refinitiv FX Trading, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent analytical and report-writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of EU trading-related regulatory requirements.
  • Self-motivated with good communication and teamwork skills.
  • Good proficiency in both spoken and written English and Chinese; German is a plus.

Benefits

  • Central Location: Your workplace is situated in the heart of Frankfurt Westend.
  • Long-Term Perspective: We are continuously growing and offer our colleagues a long-term career perspective with us.
  • Opportunities for Cross-border Training: We offer training programs and ICBC global events in China.
  • Extras: multicultural work environment, regular company events with colleagues.

Please send your complete application documents — including CV, cover letter (optional), salary expectations, and earliest possible entry date — with reference to the above-mentioned job title to us. We look forward to receiving your application!

description_html:
Wir stellen ein!

Sie
haben Freude an Personalthemen, behalten auch bei unterschiedlichen
Aufgaben den Überblick und arbeiten gerne nah an Mitarbeitenden und
Führungskräften?

erwartet eine vielseitige Position mit Verantwortung, kurzen
Abstimmungswegen und einem abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsalltag. Dabei
verbinden Sie Ihre organisatorischen Fähigkeiten mit einem sicheren
Gespür für Menschen und unterstützen uns dort, wo Struktur,
Verlässlichkeit und eine gute Kommunikation gefragt sind.

Aufgaben

Assistenz der Geschäftsbereichsleitung/Geschäftsführung

  • Laufende organisatorisch-technische Unterstützung
  • Koordination und Organisation von Terminen und Kalendern
  • Organisation und Abrechnung von Geschäftsreisen
  • Vor- und Nachbereitung von Besprechungen und Sitzungen einschließlich Protokollführung
  • Erstellung und Aufbereitung von Präsentationen, Berichten, Briefings und weiteren Unterlagen
  • Unterstützung bei der internen und externen Korrespondenz
  • Übernahme weiterer organisatorischer, administrativer und projektbezogener Aufgaben

Schwerpunkt Personalwesen

  • Eigenständige
    Betreuung und Administration des Personalwesens sowie zentrale
    Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende in personalrelevanten Fragestellungen
  • Steuerung
    und Begleitung des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses von der Erstellung und
    Veröffentlichung von Stellenausschreibungen über das Bewerbermanagement
    bis zur Koordination des Auswahlprozesses
  • Planung und Koordination des On- und Offboardings
  • Vorbereitung
    der monatlichen Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung sowie zentrale
    Schnittstelle zur externen Lohnbuchhaltung, digitale
    Personaladministration und Pflege des HR-Managementsystems
  • Koordination von Maßnahmen zur Personalentwicklung, Weiterbildung und Mitarbeiterbindung
  • Weiterentwicklung, Standardisierung und Optimierung bestehender HR-Prozesse

Qualifikation

Das suchen wir: Erfahrungen und Skills

Abgeschlossene
kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise mit Zusatzqualifikation im
Personalwesen, oder ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Personal/BWL bzw. eine
vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Fundierte Berufserfahrung im Personalwesen und gute Kenntnisse in der operativen Personalarbeit
  • Gute Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht und Sicherheit im Umgang mit personalrelevanten Fragestellungen
  • Erfahrung in der vorbereitenden Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Abrechnungsstellen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen HR-Managementsystemen und eine hohe IT-Affinität
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägtes Organisationsvermögen
  • Kommunikationsstärke und ein professioneller, serviceorientierter Umgang mit Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden
  • Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, absolute Diskretion und Loyalität

Benefits

Das bieten wir

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig mobil zu arbeiten.

  • Eine Position in Teil- oder Vollzeit mit individuellem Arbeitszeitumfang.
  • Viel Raum für eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und die Möglichkeit, Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung und enger Austausch mit unseren Führungskräften.
  • Eine vielseitige Position an der Schnittstelle zwischen Personalwesen, Organisation und Geschäftsleitung.
  • Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterbildung.

Na, Lust bekommen?

Dann
bewirb dich und werde Teil unseres Teams! Wir freuen uns auf deine
Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und
deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

Sende uns deine Unterlagen an uns per Mail.

Übrigens:
Die GLC Glücksburg Consulting AG ist seit mehr als 30 Jahren
erfolgreich in der Tourismusbranche tätig. Vom Spreewald über die
Lutherstadt Wittenberg und den Harz bis hin zur Nord- und Ostseeküste
sind wir an vielfältigen Standorten aktiv – oft dort, wo andere Urlaub
machen.

Hinter
diesen Projekten stehen Menschen, Organisation und verlässliche
Strukturen. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Unterstütze uns im
Personalbereich und in der Geschäftsleitungsassistenz und gestalte
gemeinsam mit uns die weitere Entwicklung der GLC.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Über uns

Die
GLC Glücksburg Consulting AG ist seit über 30 Jahren erfolgreicher
Projektmanager und -umsetzer für den Mittelstand und öffentliche
Auftraggeber. Ob Tourismus, IT oder Unternehmensfinanzierung - unsere
Projekte umfassen eine Vielzahl spannender Branchen und Fachbereiche und
bieten ausgesprochen gute Karriereperspektiven.

Über alle
Standorte und Fachbereiche leben wir dabei den Teamzusammenhalt und sind
der festen Überzeugung, dass wir als interdisziplinäres Team gemeinsam
mehr erreichen! Dabei haben wir stets das gemeinsame Ziel im Blick und
geben unseren Mitarbeitenden viel Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen und
umzusetzen. Kundenorientiert und schnell zu handeln, ist unser
Erfolgsgeheimnis.

Du hast Lust, an Bord zu kommen? Unser fröhliches und energiegeladenes Team aus etwa 150 Köpfen freut sich schon auf Dich!

title: Junior ML / AI Engineer - Team Data (H/F)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at WINAMAX
description_html:
Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.
 
Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?
 
Techniquement, Winamax c’est :
  • Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
  • Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
  • Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audiences

A PROPOS DU POSTE
 
Pour accompagner le développement de Winamax sur de nombreuses problématiques liées à l’analyse de données, nous recrutons un ML /AI Engineer.
 
Au sein de la team Data, tu participeras activement à la recherche et au développement de modèles de machine learning et d’IA générative afin de répondre à des problématiques complexes en optimisant les processus décisionnels, en automatisant des tâches, et en concevant des solutions innovantes adaptées aux besoins des utilisateurs.
 
Tu seras également impliqué(e) dans l'évaluation des performances des modèles, leur déploiement en production, ainsi que la veille technologique pour rester à la pointe des avancées en intelligence artificielle.
 
Tu as l'occasion unique de contribuer au développement de l’équipe avec un terrain de jeu fertile en attente d’innovation et de créativité !
 
 
LES MISSIONS DU POSTE
 
  • Identifier les besoins et les problématiques métiers et proposer des solutions concrètes et pragmatiques
  • Concevoir et maintenir des modèles de machine learning / IA générative
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques et produit
  • Effectuer une veille active sur l’ensemble des sujets ML / IA
 
QUELQUES EXEMPLES DE PROJETS
 
  • Conception d’un Chatbot
  • POC d’IA générative (génération de documentation technique, veille réglementaire, RAG à usage interne ...)
  • Analyse et modélisation de données sur différents domaines (intégrité de jeu, addiction, …)
 
ENVIRONNEMENT TECHNIQUE
 
  • Stockage : RDS, S3, DynamoDB, Redis, Redshift
  • Orchestration de containers : ECS Fargate / EC2
  •  Jobs : Lambda, Batch
  • Workflows : AirflowML : SageMaker / ML Flow
  • BI : Quicksight
  • Langages : Python, Javascript (Node)
  • Streaming : Kafka
  • CI : Github Action
  • Monitoring : Cloudwatch, Grafana

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ
Profil alliant une expérience de production en IA et ML (en stage ou alternance) à une fine compréhension des architectures de modèles LLM. La maîtrise des environnements Cloud et les compétences avancées en développement Python sont complétées par un esprit proactif, systématiquement force de proposition, et d'excellentes aptitudes en communication.

MODALITÉS ASSOCIÉES AU POSTE
  • Poste à pourvoir en CDI (contrat à durée indéterminée) temps plein uniquement et dès que possible à Paris, France
  • Semaine en 4 jours
  • Rémunération : selon le profil + participation et intéressement

    • PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT
  • Premier échange avec le recruteur - 30min
  • Live coding avec le Lead Tech et un membre de l’équipe - 1h
  • Entretien avec le Lead Tech et un membre de l’équipe - 1h30
  • Entretien final avec le VP Engineering - 30min
    • POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?
     
    En plus de notre univers poker et paris sportifs, nous avons d’autres avantages !
     
    • Une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique 
    • Une semaine de travail en 4 jours pour la majorité de nos équipes
    • Choix de l'ordinateur : PC ou MAC
    • Participation à des conférences/événements tech
    • Un cadre de travail convivial, en plein cœur de Paris (rooftop tour Eiffel, salle de jeux vidéo et salle de sport…)
    • Des possibilités de mobilité interne 
    • Une vie d’entreprise riche avec des soirées et événements organisés régulièrement (tournois de poker, soirées thématiques, barbecues tout l'été…)
    • Des primes d’intéressement et de participation 
    • Un accès au programme de cooptation (bonus de cooptation jusqu’à 5000 €)
    • Un restaurant d’entreprise (ou panier repas)
    • Une excellente mutuelle
    • 6 semaines de congés payés

title: CDI - CHEF DE PRODUIT HOMME/SLG/CEINTURE (H/F)
description_html:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

 

Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

 

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

 

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

 

VOTRE RÔLE

Au sein du pôle Développement Maroquinerie, le/la Chef(fe) de produit est garant(e), du développement des produits et du suivi des collections. En lien direct avec la Responsable Développement Maroquinerie, il/elle intervient de manière autonome sur l'ensemble de son périmètre, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes, Création Produit, Merchandising et Production.

 

VOS MISSIONS  

  • Travail en autonomie sur les offres maroquinerie homme, petite maroquinerie, ceintures et projets VIP
  • Accompagnement des fabricants dans le développement des produits, sur la base du brief du studio et du brief merchandising, déplacements sur site à prévoir
  • Gestion du parc de fabricants en collaboration avec l’équipe production (identification des forces et faiblesses, contretype)
  • Propositions d’alternatives techniques auprès du studio et des fabricants, pour anticiper les problématiques industrialisation et costing dans le respect de l’intention créative
  • Pilotage du développement des prototypes et des échantillons dans le respect des délais, de la marge et du niveau de qualité
  • Visibilité prix tout au long de la collection et négociations dans le respect des objectifs de marge
  • En charge du référencements produits et garant de l’exactitude des nomenclatures produits
  • Mise à jour des plans de collection et outils de suivi de collections
  • Support argumentaires spécificités produits pour l’équipe merchandising
  • Gestion planning shooting packshot et conformité produit en lien avec l’équipe image
  • Participation aux organisations défilé (pointage collection, mises en place produit pour editing styling et fitting, packing collection)
  • Préparation et transmission des dossiers techniques aux équipes industrialisation et production.
  • Validations facture et suivi rigoureux des coûts engagés
  • Participation à l’amélioration en continue des process

 

VOTRE PROFIL

  • Bac +3 à Bac +5 (commerce, mode ou équivalent), avec 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement produit maroquinerie et/ou petite maroquinerie, idéalement dans l'univers du luxe ou de la mode

 

  • Bonne connaissance du marché et de ses acteurs

 

  • Expérience en gestion fabricants, développement produits et analyse de dossiers techniques

 

  • Maîtrise d'Excel et des outils bureautiques ; connaissance d'un ERP/PLM fortement appréciée

 

  • Anglais professionnel indispensable, italien fortement apprécié

 

  • Forte sensibilité produit alliée à une organisation rigoureuse et un bon sens des priorités

 

  • Aisance relationnelle, esprit d'équipe, proactivité, flexibilité et sens des responsabilités

Le/La Chef de Produit Chaîne & Trame femme est en charge du développement des catégories tailleur, shirting et flou, en lien les équipes design, dans le respect des objectifs de prix, de qualité et de délais.

title: Business Development Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at RCT Solutions GmbH
description_html:
To further strengthen our growth and unlock new business potential, we are looking for an entrepreneurial, strategically minded and persuasive personality to join us as soon as possible as a Business Development Manager (m/f/d). In this role, you will actively help expand our business activities with market insight, strong negotiation skills and enthusiasm for innovative energy solutions.

Tasks

  • Identifying, evaluating, qualifying and developing new business opportunities in the fields of hydrogen, energy storage and renewable energies
  • Identifying and developing new customer, partner and project structures as well as maintaining long-term stakeholder relationships, including the development of formal partnerships
  • Analysing markets, customer needs, competition and regulatory conditions to derive concrete growth opportunities and actions
  • Developing go-to-market, partnership and market-entry strategies in national and international environments
  • Supporting the acquisition, conceptualisation and commercial development of hydrogen and storage projects
  • Preparing business cases, decision-making materials as well as market and profitability analyses
  • Preparing and conducting customer and partner meetings, presentations and negotiations
  • Working closely with Engineering, Project Management and the Management Board to implement new business approaches
  • Representing RCT GH at conferences and trade fairs

Requirements

  • A completed degree in industrial engineering, energy technology, mechanical engineering, chemical or process engineering or a comparable field
  • Several years of experience in business development, strategic sales, partner management or project business, ideally in the energy sector, hydrogen, gas process plants or comparable fields
  • Strong understanding of complex sales cycles, capital equipment and/or process technology sales
  • Sound understanding of energy markets, business models and commercial and legal interrelationships
  • Interest in hydrogen technologies, renewable energies and the energy transition
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, strong analytical skills and a high level of initiative
  • Confident presence, strong communication skills and negotiation ability
  • Independent, structured and goal-oriented way of working
  • Business-fluent German and English skills as well as willingness to travel. Additional languages are a plus
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM tools

Benefits

  • A varied and responsible role in a future-oriented technology environment
  • The opportunity to actively contribute to innovative solutions for the energy supply of the future
  • A dynamic, committed team with short decision-making paths and an open, collegial company culture
  • A challenging area of responsibility with a high degree of autonomy and plenty of room to shape your work
  • Attractive and performance-based remuneration
  • An attractive workplace in Konstanz within a high-growth company environment
  • The chance to actively help shape market expansion in hydrogen storage technology

We offer you the opportunity to apply your business development experience in a technologically demanding and forward-looking market environment, actively develop new business potential and work with us to drive the expansion of innovative hydrogen solutions.

title: (Senior) Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Next Lotto GmbH
description_html:
Ein kleines Stück Papier mit Zahlen, die das Potenzial haben, ein Leben für immer zu verändern! Ok…ersetzten wir das Papier durch eine App und eine Person gegen 600.000+ Nutzer monatlich. This is our Business!

📌 Deine Mission:

Als (Senior) Social Media Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest du Strategie, Kampagnen und Content-Rhythmus end-to-end — von der Idee über die eigene Produktion bis zur Veröffentlichung. Reichweite ist dabei Mittel, nicht Ziel: Du bringst Menschen in die App und in Tipp-Teams, setzt Markenmomente, die hängen bleiben, und machst aus stillen Followern eine aktive Community - hands-on und mit einem Fokus, der sich je nach Priorität dynamisch verschiebt.

Aufgaben

  • Du baust unsere organischen Kanäle Instagram, TikTok und LinkedIn eigenverantwortlich auf und verantwortest den kompletten Content-Plan — von Strategie über Produktion bis zur Veröffentlichung.
  • Du produzierst Content selbst hands-on — Konzept, Dreh mit dem Smartphone, Schnitt und Copy. Du wartest nicht auf Zulieferungen, sondern lieferst.
  • Du arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Creative-, Motion- , UA- und das gesamte Marketing- Team zusammen und koordinierst und briefst diese sowie weitere Stakeholder bei größeren Produktionen.
  • Du managst unsere Community skalierbar und interagierst aktiv mit Kommentaren, DMs und User Generated Content.
  • Du koordinierst Paid-Social-Storytelling gemeinsam mit dem UA Manager und stellst die Abstimmung zwischen organischen und bezahlten Maßnahmen sicher (ohne direkte Paid- Verantwortung).
  • Du misst und berichtest wöchentlich sowie monatlich relevante Social KPIs — Reichweite, Engagement, Follower-Wachstum sowie App-Install- und Tipp-Team-Attribution.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Legal zusammen und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen (insb. GlüStV, GGL) sicher, ohne kreative Ansätze einzuschränken.
  • Du bist bei wichtigen Brand-Aktivierungen vor Ort, um Content zu erstellen und maximale Aufmerksamkeit zu generieren.
  • Du identifizierst und testest neue Kanäle wie Pinterest, Reddit und weitere.

Deine Ziele in dieser Rolle

  • Organische Reichweite skalieren - Follower-Wachstum auf Instagram und TikTok um 30–50% innerhalb von 12 Monaten; Vervierfachung der monatlichen Impressions.
  • Messbare Nutzerakquise vorantreiben - definierte monatliche Ziele für App-Installationen und Tipp-Team-Beitritte über organisches Social erreichen.
  • Aktivitäten verstärken - dokumentierten Content-Plan umsetzen, UGC systematisch erfassen und distribuieren sowie Engagement-Benchmarks erreichen.
  • Content-Standards etablieren - Playbook zu Tonalität, Formaten, Posting-Cadence und Response-Standards entwickeln.
  • Social-Kompetenz ausbauen - als Grundlage für den Launch des Tipp-Team Large-Team-Modus.

title: Head of Operations & Service - Dosimetry
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at IBA Dosimetry GmbH
description_html:
General Mission

Reporting to the Business Unit President, the Head of Operations & Service is responsible for defining and executing the global operations strategy to support the growth, profitability and customer satisfaction objectives of the Dosimetry business. The role ensures the effective management of worldwide manufacturing, supply chain, order fulfillment and customer service activities, while building a resilient and scalable operational model. As a member of the Dosimetry leadership team, the position works closely with the Radiotherapy (RT) and Medical Imaging (MI) Business line, Finance, R&D, Quality and Regulatory Affairs, Business Unit President and People function to align operational priorities with business needs.

Tasks

  • Lead and continuously optimize worldwide manufacturing and supply chain operations across production sites in the United States, Germany and China, ensuring reliable product availability, operational efficiency and business continuity.
  • Define the long-term manufacturing footprint and sourcing strategy, including make-versus-buy decisions, component manufacturing approaches, and production site allocation.
  • Partner with Finance and MI – RT Business Lines to align demand forecasts, production planning and delivery commitments, ensuring accurate capacity planning and execution.
  • Lead global customer service organizations across the United States, Germany, India and China, ensuring a seamless customer experience and responsive support across all regions.
  • Oversee end-to-end order fulfillment processes from order intake to delivery, driving operational excellence, process standardization, and continuous improvement. Establish a performance-driven culture through the use of operational metrics, effective governance, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Build, develop and lead international teams, fostering accountability, collaboration and engagement.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards, regulatory requirements and health and safety guidelines.
  • Support and promote IBA values while contributing to the achievement of the overall Dosimetry business strategy.

Requirements

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business objectives into operational strategy
  • Strong leadership and people management skills in an international and multicultural environment
  • Expertise in manufacturing, supply chain, customer service and operations management
  • Business acumen with strong understanding of forecasting, planning and financial drivers
  • Customer-centric approach with a focus on service excellence
  • Ability to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement
  • Strong decision-making and problem-solving capabilities
  • Influencing and stakeholder management skills across functions and geographies
  • Ability to manage complexity, balance priorities and deliver results
  • Accountability and ownership with a strong focus on execution and outcomes
  • Fluent in English and German language

Benefits

Diverse and challenging tasks / personal responsibility and teamwork / international and dynamic team / regular internal and external training - development and coaching / flexible working hours and home office / healthy breakfast and team events / a remuneration system that rewards your success/ 30 vacation days

Please apply directly online with salary expectation and start day.

Please note that we only accept online applications. Written application documents sent nevertheless will not be included in the application process and will not be returned.

Thank you for your understanding!

If you have any questions, please turn to Onyinye Nfiaji directly in LinkedIn.

title: Software Engineer Intern, Trading
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Talos Trading
description_html:
Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Software Engineer Intern, Trading

Talos is seeking a Software Engineering Intern to join our Trading team for the Summer 2027. This intern will work on a critical project related to our high-performance trading systems, contributing to tools that support trading decision-making and performance evaluation. Success in this role will involve designing and building components that enhance our algorithmic capabilities while adding new features to existing infrastructure.

Want to learn more about Talos’s engineering culture? Check out Sonic, our first open-source project which allows Talos to achieve microsecond network stack latency in Go: https://github.com/talostrading/sonic

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the Trading team to define project scope, requirements, and milestones

  • Prepare design documentation and actively participate in architectural discussions with team members

  • Build features in Go to enhance Talos's Order Management System (OMS), which is responsible for making all trading related decisions for orders submitted into Talos to ensure best execution

  • Add analytics and metrics to measure impact of your changes while incorporating feedback and iterating based on team input

  • Demonstrate project progress through regular demos

Qualifications

  • Class of 2028 pursuing a degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Proficiency in at least one compiled language (e.g., Go, C++, Java)

  • At least one previous internship involving working on backend systems in a production environment, preferably in a user-facing context

  • Knowledge of relational databases (e.g Postgres)

  • Past experience with trading systems is a plus

  • Detail-oriented, self driven, analytical, and enthusiastic about working on impactful projects

  • Strong communication skills, with an ability to convey technical concepts clearly

  • Ability to work autonomously as well as a part of a collaborative team environment

  • Energetic, creative, and a self-starter who can manage tasks autonomously

Learn More About Talos

Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture!

  • Spotlight Article: Talos Snapshot by DRW

  • Podcast: 2023 episode with co-founders Anton & Ethan

  • Website: Explore Talos: Products, Investors, Team & More

  • Case Studies: Real world examples of client solutions

  • Awards: Talos Wins Hedgeweek Global Digital Assets Award 2024

  • Culture: Award-winning, Forbes-listed, low-attrition team

Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company."

Benefits

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

  • A lunch credit of $25 USD towards lunches for days in-office

  • Evening socials with the entire office and fellow interns

  • Other in-office perks: Catered lunches on Tuesdays, snacks, and drinks

Also, check out other open positions listed on our website.

  • Cross-functionally communicate with teams to understand and implement infrastructure requirements

  • Be part of an open and transparent culture

  • Exposure to cloud platforms and online hosting (e.g. AWS, GCP)

  • Interest in distributed systems and platform engineering

title: Senior Account Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Kota
description_html:
About Kota

Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products, Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution, we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.

Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors like EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, along with founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.


The Role

We're hiring a Senior Account Manager in our Embed team to own and manage the relationship with our strategic customers. This role requires managing a portfolio of enterprise clients and acting as their strategic commercial partner: driving expansion across new countries, deepening stakeholder relationships, and surfacing insights that shape our product and operational priorities.

As we expand into new geographies and onboard more complex enterprise clients, we need someone who can drive growth, strengthen relationships, and make sure partners get the full value of Kota Embed.

You're joining at a moment of real momentum for Embed. New clients, markets and opportunities are coming online fast, which brings both challenge and the chance to make a genuine impact.


What You'll Do

  • Drive client growth: expand usage across new countries, product modules and eligible populations, and build clear account plans, forecasts and expansion roadmaps

  • Spot upsell and expansion triggers early, then coordinate internally to execute them

  • Own strategic relationships as the primary contact for post-launch Embed clients, building multi-level relationships across their Product, Ops and Commercial teams

  • Run structured QBRs that align stakeholders and drive long-term partnership value.

  • Own client-level escalations (not consumer queries), coordinating resolution across Product, Integrations, Expansion & Benefits, and Embed Operations, and keeping clients informed through issues or delays

  • Track account performance across revenue, lives, satisfaction and operational health, surfacing trends and risks early and turning them into clear action

  • Champion the voice of the client: distil feedback into insights for Product, Expansion and Ops, and help shape the Embed partnership model and lifecycle as we scale


What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in account management, partnerships or customer success

  • Strong relationship builder, confident with senior stakeholders and delivering board level presentations

  • Experience of managing large complex renewals and multi year engagements

  • Crafting of complex propositions, straddling technical, commercial and support

  • Thrives in a dynamic, unstructured startup environment

  • Iterates and executes quickly - has built process and strategies in previous high growth organisations

  • Highly organised, thrives under pressure, able to manage multiple clients at pace

  • Experience of going from zero to one and building new commercial frameworks

  • Has sold and managed technical products previously - can quickly move between reading a balance sheet and technical API documentation

  • Prior experience in health insurance, benefits, EOR/GP or SaaS/Fintech is a big plus


Our Values

  • Have Integrity. We care deeply about our why and it won't jeopardise our how.

  • Care Deeply. Our products are our story, we look at the details, go the extra mile to delight customers.

  • Own Your Ship. Ask why, do the work, get the data, solve the problem, be an owner.

  • Raise the Bar. We continuously look to push past good enough. Expect more, move faster, and never stop raising your and the team's standards.

  • Play to Win. We exist because we decided to say no to the norm, now we do this everyday.


Kota Benefits

  • Health Insurance via Kota

  • Workplace Pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota

  • WFH stipend to support your home office

  • Generous Paid Time Off, work hard and recharge fully

  • Annual company-wide offsite + dedicated team offsite

title: Director, Customer Success
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Creatoriq
description_html:
CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies.

We’re on a mission to make businesses more human, and humans more impactful. We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles.

We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together!

Director, Customer Success (EMEA)

As our EMEA Customer Success organization continues to evolve, we're looking for a strategic and commercially minded Customer Success leader to help shape the next phase of growth for our customers, team, and business.

As Director, Customer Success, you'll lead a team of Customer Success Professionals while helping some of the world's leading brands maximize the value of CreatorIQ. You'll bring a combination of Customer Success leadership, enterprise commercial expertise, and creator marketing knowledge to drive retention, growth, and long-term partnership success across EMEA. As a member of the EMEA Customer Success leadership team, you'll own portfolio performance, forecasting, strategic customer engagement, team development, and operational excellence while helping shape the future of Customer Success at CreatorIQ.

Location: London, UK (Hybrid, 3 days per week in office)

Travel: Approximately 20% travel across EMEA customer locations.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Success Professionals while fostering a culture of accountability, performance, and customer-centricity.

  • Own portfolio performance across EMEA, driving customer retention, growth, forecasting accuracy, risk mitigation, and long-term customer success.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and help enterprise brands maximize the impact and maturity of their creator marketing programs.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Professional Services, and Support to advocate for customer needs and influence strategic business outcomes.

  • Apply industry knowledge and market insights to help customers evolve their creator marketing strategies and achieve measurable business outcomes.

  • Serve as a senior leader within the EMEA organization, driving escalations, operational priorities, organizational development, and cross-functional initiatives.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • 8+ years of experience leading Enterprise Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, or related customer-facing teams within SaaS, MarTech, AdTech, Social Media Technology, or Creator Marketing organizations.

  • Proven experience leading Enterprise Customer Success or Strategic Account teams with responsibility for retention, renewals, expansion, customer growth, and portfolio performance.

  • Demonstrated success developing and leading high-performing Customer Success Professionals and Managers while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Strong executive presence with experience advising senior stakeholders, including CMOs, Heads of Influencer Marketing, Heads of Social, VPs, and other senior business leaders.

  • Strong commercial acumen with ownership of retention, revenue growth, forecasting, and strategic customer outcomes.

  • Experience managing strategic enterprise customer relationships, executive business reviews, complex escalations, and high-impact customer risk situations.

  • Ability to independently lead cross-functional initiatives and influence outcomes across Sales, Product, Marketing, Professional Services, and Support teams.

  • Direct experience within influencer marketing, creator economy, creator technology, social media technology, MarTech, or a closely related industry strongly preferred. Candidates from creator marketing platforms, social/creator agencies, or brand-side creator marketing organizations are especially encouraged to apply.

  • Demonstrated understanding of creator marketing trends, influencer strategy, measurement frameworks, and the evolving creator economy landscape.

  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, customer insights, forecasting, operational efficiency, and customer engagement.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow.

What you will get from us:

  • People: work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you’ll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days vacation, floating and set holidays, wellness allowance, and paid parental leave.

  • Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Healthcare coverage, encompassing mental health, physical therapies, dental, vision, cancer coverage, and more.

  • Comprehensive perks program providing stipends for wellness, cell phone and internet, home office setup, mental wellness, professional development, plus occasional company-funded meal opportunities throughout the year.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth. Trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies—including Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé, and Sephora—CreatorIQ unifies creator marketing across paid, owned, earned, commerce, and community into one seamless, enterprise-grade ecosystem. With industry-leading intelligence infrastructure, rigorous compliance and security standards, and integrations with Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, YouTube, and more, CreatorIQ empowers brands and agencies to harness the creator economy as a strategic growth engine. CreatorIQ is a global company headquartered in Los Angeles with offices in Austin, New York, San Francisco, London, Manila, and Warsaw. Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, we believe that diversity is the key to unlocking our full potential. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, being a good human, and staying focused on what’s important, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

Compensation, Benefits and Beyond:

We understand that a comprehensive benefits package plays a significant role in your overall compensation. To gain more insight into the various components of our total compensation, we invite you to review our benefits and perks.

AI Transparency Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Technical Sales / Field Operations Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Alta Ares
description_html:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role and Mission:

• Lead in-depth presentations and product demonstrations, field trials, and proof of concepts across UK MoD stakeholders, potential integration partners and defence engineering firms. This applies across Alta Ares’ ISR, C-UAS and AI portfolio

• Author technical responses to capability briefs, solicited and unsolicited proposals, completing detailed compliance matrices; tailoring bespoke product descriptions and presentations.

• Support the Sales Director with Business Development across UK stakeholders by becoming a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Alta Ares’ product portfolio, this will require initial technical onboarding experience in locations across France, and potentially Ukraine

• Liaise between Sales and Products & Engineering, ensuring that customer requests are technically supportable (and able to meet timelines requirements)

• Monitor and understand the competitor landscape in the UK across similar platforms to the Alta Ares product portfolio

Candidate Profile:

• 3+ years of experience in technical sales and product demonstrations in the Defence market

• Military Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) and/or Counter-UAS (C-UAS) experience (or relatable civilian experience)

• General Visual Line of Sight Certificate (GVC), Remote Pilot Competency Level 1

• Experience working with munitions and ordnance

• Proven and robust logistical planning skills

• Highly-effective communicator (oral and written)

• Willingness to travel overseas if required

Nice to Have:

• Remote Pilot Qualifications (RPC-L1 to RPC-L4)

• Experience in a Defence start-up, neo-prime or prime
